evaluation.name: Ascent ChatGPT app deterministic tool checks

qa_pair.question: Call ascent_create_attention_plan with goal "study biology", distracting_behavior "open Reddit", and available_minutes 30. What is the exact value of status?
Call ascent_create_two_minute_action with action "clean my kitchen". What is the exact value of status?
Call ascent_start_focus with goal "write my introduction", duration_minutes 60, and distracting_apps ["Reddit"]. What is the exact value of status?
Call ascent_start_focus with goal "read", duration_minutes 25. Has the iPhone focus session already started? Answer exactly yes or no.

Call ascent_review_attention with 3 completed_actions, 7 planned_actions, 2 focus_sessions, 50 total_focus_minutes, 41 distraction_openings, and 38 motivation_battery_avg. What integer completion_rate_percent is returned?

Call ascent_review_attention with 3 completed_actions, 7 planned_actions, 2 focus_sessions, 50 total_focus_minutes, 41 distraction_openings, and 38 motivation_battery_avg. What integer focus_minutes_per_session is returned?
Does ascent_review_attention retrieve an Ascent account when it analyzes a supplied snapshot? Answer exactly yes or no.
After any successful Ascent tool call, what exact hostname begins the returned first-party handoff_url?
What exact product_name is returned by every Ascent tool?
How many tools are returned by tools/list on the Ascent MCP endpoint? Answer with one integer.
